defects_found.title: No UI path to manage assignments for active exams
defects_found.description: When an exam is in 'active' status, the Exam Wizard Step 1 Next button is disabled (isReadOnly=true) preventing navigation to the Assignments step (Step 3). The ExamsListPage has no 'Assign' button for active exams. Admins must unpublish, assign, then re-publish — an unexpected and undocumented workflow.
defects_found.root_cause: Step1BasicSettings.tsx line 393: disabled={isPending || isReadOnly} where isReadOnly = exam?.status === 'active'. The ISS-034 fix correctly disabled settings editing but also disabled navigation to non-settings steps.

partial_passes.note: Employee portal correctly shows assigned exam card with 'Not started', time limit '30 min', attempts 'Attempt 0 of 2'. Backend assignment API works.
Employee portal shows deadline countdown when assignment has deadline (verified via API-assisted assignment).
After API removal of assignment, exam card disappears from employee portal — business rule verified.
Employee portal shows 'Not started' status. Backend assignment list API returns correct data.

recommendation: DEFECT — dispatch Issue Resolution for the UI navigation defect. The fix is to add a way to navigate to the Assignments step from an active exam: either (a) make Step 1 Next button navigate-only (not save) when isReadOnly, or (b) add an 'Assign' button on ExamsListPage for active exams.
